parts.text: [excited] Agent ID Red Packets. [break] Red packets on BNB Chain that only Agent ID holders can claim, grabbed by your own AI agent.
parts.en: Agent ID Red Packets: red packets on BNB Chain that only Agent ID holders can claim, grabbed by your own AI agent.
parts.zh: Agent ID 红包：BNB Chain 上只有 Agent ID 持有者能领的红包，由你自己的 AI Agent 来抢。

parts.text: [confident] Every person has one permanent Agent ID.
parts.en: Every person has one permanent Agent ID.
parts.zh: 每个人只有一个永久的 Agent ID。

parts.text: [confident] So one share per Agent ID really means one share per person,
parts.en: So one share per Agent ID really means one share per person,
parts.zh: 所以“每个 Agent ID 一份”就是“每人一份”，

parts.text: [confident] and new wallets don't help bots.
parts.en: and new wallets don't help bots.
parts.zh: 机器人换再多钱包也没用。
发一个红包只要一分钟。

parts.text: [relaxed] Choose a code packet, set the amount, and the number of shares.
parts.en: Choose a code packet, set the amount, and the number of shares.
parts.zh: 选口令红包，填金额和份数。

parts.text: [relaxed] BNB, USDT, USDC, or any BSC token.
parts.en: BNB, USDT, USDC, or any BSC token.
parts.zh: BNB、USDT、USDC 或 BSC 上任意代币都行。

parts.text: [happy] Post the share text in your group.
parts.en: Post the share text in your group.

parts.text: [happy] Every packet gets its own link, and its own preview card.
parts.en: Every packet gets its own link, and its own preview card.
parts.zh: 每个红包都有自己的链接和专属预览图。

parts.text: [confident] Holders hand the text to their AI agent.
parts.en: Holders hand the text to their AI agent.
parts.zh: 领红包的人把分享文字交给自己的 AI Agent。

parts.text: [confident] It checks their Agent ID, and previews the transaction in Binance Agentic Wallet,
parts.en: It checks their Agent ID, and previews the transaction in Binance Agentic Wallet,
parts.zh: 它会核对 Agent ID，并在 Binance Agentic Wallet 里预览交易，

parts.text: [confident] and claims only after they confirm.
parts.en: and claims only after they confirm.

parts.text: [curious] Lucky amounts come from the hash of the block the grab lands in, so nobody can simulate a grab and cherry-pick.
parts.en: Lucky amounts come from the hash of the block the grab lands in, so nobody can simulate a grab and cherry-pick.
parts.zh: 拼手气金额由抢红包那个区块的哈希决定，谁也没法先模拟、再挑金额。

parts.text: [confident] An eighty-bit share code keeps chain bots out.
parts.en: An 80-bit share code keeps chain bots out.
parts.zh: 80 位随机红包码挡住链上机器人。

parts.text: [confident] Heavy grabbers of public packets wait in line.
parts.en: Heavy grabbers of public packets wait in line.
parts.zh: 公开红包抢得多的人往后排。

parts.text: [confident] No owner, no fees, no upgrades, and the contract is verified on B-S-C Scan.
parts.en: No owner, no fees, no upgrades, and the contract is verified on BscScan.
parts.zh: 合约没有管理员、不收手续费、不可升级，并在 BscScan 开源验证。

parts.text: [delighted] Try it at agent I D dot I M, and let your agent grab red packets.
parts.en: Try it at agentid.im, and let your agent grab red packets.
parts.zh: 来 agentid.im 试试，让你的 Agent 去抢红包。
